Diagnosis.submission: The frontend service is in a crash loop caused by a misconfigured liveness probe. The liveness probe has two issues: (1) the probe path is set to /healthz which does not exist on the Next.js frontend application (returns HTTP 404), and (2) the failureThreshold is set to 1 instead of the standard 3, meaning any single failed probe check immediately causes a restart. Together, these cause the frontend to restart every ~20 seconds, making it unavailable. The fix was to change the liveness probe path from /healthz to / (the root path which returns HTTP 200) and increase the failureThreshold from 1 to 3.
